intro: A recruiter resume that shows hires made, how fast and how well: time to fill, offer acceptance, and how long hires stayed.
tips: Give the number and kinds of roles you filled.
Show time to fill, offer acceptance and retention of hires.
Mention sourcing channels and the tools you used.

work.summary: SaaS company, grew from 150 to 400 staff.

Cut average time to fill from 52 days to 34 with structured interviews and faster feedback.
Built a referral programme that now brings 30% of hires.
